senses.gloss: [(b. h.) to stand erect, bristle.—Denom. מַסְמֵר; whence סָמַר] to nail, fasten.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:11:2">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>זְמָרוֹ</he> he nailed it (against the door, in an inappropriate place).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:2">Sabb. VI, 2</cite>, a. fr. <he>סנדל המס׳</he> a nail-studded shoe.
